conviction_note: Two forces of similar weight. On fundamentals I lean slightly negative: Q3 revenue consensus of about RMB3.0bn needs about +8% QoQ when Q2 grew +3.3% QoQ, and FY guide midpoint needs H2 to grow faster than Q2's +14.2%. On positioning I lean positive: 16% of ADS outstanding (about 26% of the float outside CATL-linked holders) is short, about 7 days to cover, the stock is -57% since the last print and -28.6% in five sessions, and the hyperscaler counterparties (Tencent, Alibaba) raised capex sharply after VNET last spoke. Net, the findings sum is -0.2 and p_up 52 x abs 12 gives +0.48. The two numbers differ in sign only marginally and both are close to zero, which is the honest read: a large move with no confident direction.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about RMB3.0bn: Chartmill RMB3.002B (estimate cut 2.15% over 3 months, per search snippet of https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/VNET/estimates; the page itself returned 403) and the finviz preview of 2026-11-15 at $441.9m, which converts to about RMB3.0bn at the Q2 release's RMB6.79/$ (https://finviz.com/news/422859/vnets-gigawatt-bookings-face-a-move-in-test-as-the-stock-sits-near-its-lows). Benzinga shows $452.9m (about RMB3.07bn). EPS bars disagree badly ($0.53 vs -$0.02 vs -CN¥0.24) and are not used. Company FY2026 guide, reiterated 2026-08-18: revenue RMB11.5-11.8bn, adj. EBITDA RMB3.55-3.75bn, capex RMB10-12bn (https://finviz.com/news/383066/vnet-reports-unaudited-second-quarter-2026-financial-results). Per the preview, FY consensus of $1.74bn sits near the top of the USD-translated guide.
positioning_check: Short interest was 46,026,467 ADS at the 2026-10-30 settlement, down from 47,966,889 on 10-15. That is 6.88 days to cover on 6.69m average volume and about 16.1% of 285.2m ADS outstanding (https://equibles.com/stocks/vnet/shortinterest). The 11-13 settlement is not yet published; the model estimate is 44.9m. PJ Millennium (CATL-linked) holds 38.1%, so the short is roughly 26% of the remaining float. Against today's 20-day average volume of 6.96m (baseline), days to cover is about 6.6. Chartmill's '101% of float' looks like a float error. 25-delta skew is null in the baseline. Put/call open-interest ratio is 0.18, so the open interest is call-heavy. The ATM IV of 133.6% and the 29.36% straddle to 2026-12-18 decompose to an event move of only 5.38%, because ordinary 20-day realised volatility is 128%. One day at that volatility is about 8.1%. The tape: -28.6% over 5 days, -42.8% over 20 days, at the 52-week low, -84.8% from the February 2026 high.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue consensus is about RMB3.0bn (Chartmill RMB3.002B; finviz preview $441.9m, about RMB3.0bn), which needs about +8% QoQ from Q2's RMB2.78bn. Q2 grew only +3.3% QoQ (Q1 RMB2.69bn) on 57MW of net wholesale move-ins (687MW to 744MW utilised), and management guided only a 'marginally faster move-in pace in the second half', tied partly to domestic chip supply. On that run-rate Q3 lands nearer RMB2.88-2.95bn, a 2-4% miss against the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-18): revenue RMB2.78bn against a RMB2.80bn consensus, guide merely reiterated. The stock closed -16.92% (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/VNET/). Q1 2026 (2026-05-26): revenue in line (RMB2.69bn vs RMB2.66bn), up about 5% in early trade (https://www.rttnews.com/3655401/vnet-q1-loss-widens-despite-higher-revenue-confirms-fy26-outlook-stock-up.aspx). The close is unverified.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews quote the consensus as +21.8% YoY in USD and call it 'ambitious', but none sets it against the Q2 QoQ run-rate and move-in pace. The Q3 estimate has been trimmed only 2.15% in three months. If the market had priced a miss, the published estimate would have moved toward RMB2.9bn. Instead the stock has fallen 57% on sector and policy news while the estimate held.
findings.independence: Q2 move-in and utilisation figures come from the Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/383066/vnet-reports-unaudited-second-quarter-2026-financial-results). The consensus comes from the finviz preview (https://finviz.com/news/422859/vnets-gigawatt-bookings-face-a-move-in-test-as-the-stock-sits-near-its-lows), which also says analysts saw Q2 wholesale revenue as light on move-in pace. The guidance finding below uses the same quarterly revenue series, but it rests on a different line (the FY range against H2 growth).

findings.finding: H1 2026 revenue was RMB5.47bn (Q1 2.69 + Q2 2.78), +16.9% YoY. The FY guide of RMB11.5-11.8bn needs H2 of RMB6.03-6.33bn: +14.4% YoY at the low end against H2 2025 of about RMB5.27bn (Q3 2.58 + Q4 about 2.69), and +17.3% at the midpoint. Q2 YoY growth slowed to +14.2% from +19.8% in Q1, and FY consensus sits near the top of the range, so a trim toward the low end is the likelier guide action.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-08-18 a reiterated guide with a midpoint just below consensus (RMB11.65bn vs 11.69bn) was part of a -16.92% close. GDS fell 13% in Hong Kong on normalised Q1 growth of 7.9% (https://www.mingtiandi.com/?p=451356), so this sector punishes growth deceleration.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus still sits near the top of the range per the 2026-11-15 preview. If a cut were priced, FY estimates would sit at or below the RMB11.5bn low end. The low end is reachable at Q2's growth rate, so this is a trim or narrowing risk, not a collapse.
findings.independence: FY consensus position comes from https://finviz.com/news/422859/vnets-gigawatt-bookings-face-a-move-in-test-as-the-stock-sits-near-its-lows. FY2025 revenue of RMB9.95bn comes from the Q4 2025 release (https://finviz.com/news/337345/vnet-reports-unaudited-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results). This finding shares the quarterly revenue arithmetic with the Q3 finding above, so the two are correlated.

findings.finding: Two likely wholesale counterparties raised capex sharply after VNET last spoke. Tencent's Q3 2026 capex was RMB81.4bn (+527% YoY, against about RMB55.4bn expected; reported 2026-11-18). Alibaba's September-quarter capex rose 60% to RMB50.5bn, with AI cloud revenue +53% and external-customer cloud +64% (reported 2026-11-19). Against that, Tencent called cash capex 'at peak' and Alibaba pointed to 30-45% cloud growth next year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No record of VNET reacting to a hyperscaler capex print. In May 2026 UBS named GDS and VNET top picks on expected 2H26 acceleration, and VNET is down about 75% since.
findings.why_not_priced: VNET fell further on 11-18 to 11-20, the two days these prints landed, so the tape treated them as nothing or as negative ('capex peak'). If the market read them as demand for third-party capacity, VNET would have bounced with them. VNET's next guide and its order commentary are the first place the transmission can show.
findings.independence: Alibaba: https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9210274/alibaba-stocks-rise-283-as-ai-cloud-revenue-jumps-53-but-cash-burn-deepens and https://fourweekmba.com/ai-alibaba-sees-30-45-cloud-growth-next-year-down-from-53/. Tencent capex vs expectations: https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/tencent-700-hk-q3-2026-cny-revenue-20734bln-exp-21053bln and https://cryptobriefing.com/tencent-negative-free-cash-flow-q3-ai/. This is a proxy: VNET's 345MW Q2 order came from an unnamed 'leading cloud service provider' in Greater Beijing, and neither company is confirmed as that customer.

findings.finding: The short is crowded into capitulation: 46.0m ADS short (10-30 settlement), about 16% of ADS outstanding and about 26% of the float outside the 38.1% CATL-linked holder, 6.9 days to cover. The stock is -57% since the last print (finviz preview, at $2.98) and has fallen another 28.6% in five sessions to $2.13 (baseline). That is about 75% below the $8.69 per ADS that the CATL-linked buyers paid in the secondary that closed 2026-09-21.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No VNET-specific squeeze on record in this sample. LESSONS records two shorts at 18% and 23% of float that squeezed 24-26% on prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is not a fact the market misses; it is the mechanism by which an 'in-line, guide held' print becomes a large up-move. The call-heavy open interest (put/call 0.18) means upside convexity is held. If this were fully priced, short interest would have been covered into the lows, but it only fell 4% from 10-15 to 10-30.
findings.independence: CATL-linked purchase price of $8.6914 per ADS: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-13/catl-linked-investors-to-buy-vnet-stake-in-942-million-deal. Since-last-print drawdown: https://finviz.com/news/422859/vnets-gigawatt-bookings-face-a-move-in-test-as-the-stock-sits-near-its-lows.

findings.finding: BIS issued an interim final rule on 2026-11-16. Any data center worldwide now needs a licence to give Chinese-headquartered firms more than 12m TPP of US-chip compute, with 90 days for existing arrangements. In Q2 VNET bought 478MW of overseas land bank and named Southeast Asia as its first overseas project, so management may scale back or defer the overseas plan. VNET fell about 10-11% that day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: VNET closed -11.41% on 2026-11-16, the day of the rule and of the CATL director appointment (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/VNET/).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the -11% day already happened. What is open is whether management quantifies overseas exposure or cuts the overseas capex plan on the call. A cut could equally read as positive for free cash flow.
findings.independence: Market reaction attribution: https://www.tradingview.com/news/stockstory:dfa9d3d45094b:0-nebius-group-d-wave-quantum-and-vnet-group-shares-are-falling-what-you-need-to-know/. Overseas land bank: https://finviz.com/news/383066/vnet-reports-unaudited-second-quarter-2026-financial-results. No company statement on exposure.

findings.finding: There is a funding gap to close in H2. H1 capex was RMB3.55bn against a FY guide of RMB10-12bn, implying RMB6.5-8.5bn in H2, against RMB7.21bn of cash and short-term investments at 6-30 and net debt/EBITDA up to 4.6x from 3.8x. On 10-27 VNET spent about $80m to buy back 30% of its 2% 2027 notes, and the CATL investor-rights agreement creates a new 'budget and financing committee'. The money funds visible demand (862MW of YTD wholesale wins, about 355MW of reservations, and the RMB7.2bn REIT recycling channel), so this is signed near zero: an equity raise at $2 would be dilutive, while a CATL-backed or REIT-funded plan would lift the overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print-day financing event on record. The 10-27 note buyback day closed down about 5% (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-vnet-group-nasdaq-vnet-stock-falls-53-heres-why-2026-10-27/).
findings.why_not_priced: The market appears to price a dilutive raise; the stock trading 75% under the strategic buyer's price is consistent with that. Which way the funding plan goes resolves on the call.
findings.independence: Note buyback: https://finviz.com/news/408743/vnet-announces-repurchase-of-30-of-its-convertible-senior-notes-due-2027. Financing committee and investor rights: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/VNET/. REIT recycling of RMB7.2bn: https://wap.stockstar.com/detail/IG2026072700034680. Net debt/EBITDA of 4.6x: the finviz preview.

findings.finding: The CATL-linked holder (38.1% since 2026-09-21) put CATL's Industrial Investment head Fuqiang Wang on the board on 2026-11-16, and management said in August it would present its 'future operating strategy and outlook in Q4 2026'. The Q3 call is the natural venue for a CATL compute-energy plan or new medium-term targets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CATL stake announcement of 2026-05-13 sent the stock sharply higher (https://ts2.tech/en/vnet-stock-surges-as-catl-linked-buyers-move-for-38-stake-in-china-ai-data-center-bet/). The August CATL cooperation agreement came out the same day as the -16.9% print.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock fell 11% on the day of the director appointment, so the market reads CATL involvement as no support at all. A concrete plan or financing commitment from a 38% holder that bought at $8.69 would be new information.
findings.independence: Strategy outlook timing: https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262115928-tradingkey. Purchase price: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-13/catl-linked-investors-to-buy-vnet-stake-in-942-million-deal. This shares the investor-rights document with the financing finding.

findings.finding: GAAP headline is likely to swing on the convertibles' fair-value line. VNET runs convertible notes (RMB4.84bn carrying value at 6-30) through 'changes in fair value of financial instruments': Q1 2026's net loss of RMB2.23bn came while the stock rose, and Q2 had a RMB47.1m fair-value loss. With the ADS down sharply over Q3, a fair-value gain is likely and a headline swing to GAAP profit is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 RMB2.23bn loss headline coincided with an early +5% move, so this line has not driven the reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: EPS consensus is incoherent across sources ($0.53 vs -$0.02), so a headline GAAP 'beat' could print against a stale bar. The item is below operating income and has no path to guidance.
findings.independence: Q2 fair-value loss and convertible carrying value: https://finviz.com/news/383066/vnet-reports-unaudited-second-quarter-2026-financial-results. The size of the Q3 gain is my inference from the share-price path, not a disclosed figure.

outside_window.finding: GDS Holdings reports Q3 2026 before the US open on 2026-11-25, after the exit window. Its order and move-in commentary is the closest peer read and lands too late for this trade.
The 90-day licence deadline under the 2026-11-16 BIS rule falls about mid-February 2027, so any effect on VNET's overseas plans resolves outside the window.

searched_and_found_nothing: A single company-specific trigger for the fall from about $6 (October) to $2.13: no short-seller report, delisting notice, entity-list action, equity offering or guidance withdrawal found for October-November 2026. The only dated catalysts are the 11-16 BIS rule and director appointment, the 10-27 note buyback and the 08-18 print.
Onshore REIT or ABS issuance in Q3 2026: the three institutional REITs (RMB7.2bn) all priced between November 2025 and March 2026; no Q3 deal found.
Named identity of the 345MW 'leading cloud service provider' customer: not disclosed.
Macquarie initiation at $5.40 (Simply Wall St, 2026-11-14): could not confirm the note itself; search returned only a Macquarie GDS initiation.

A verified historical print-day close series: the baseline history is empty (SEC 403). Only Q2 2026 (-16.92%) is sourced; Q1 2026 (about +5% early) and Q4 2025 (-2% to -4% after hours) are unverified.

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and an empty history. A -42.8% 20-day run-up and a 128% realised volatility make the 5.38% event-implied move look too small. My slight fundamental negative points the same way as the tape, so it is probably partly priced; positioning (a crowded short, call-heavy open interest) cuts against continuation, which is why p_up sits at 52 and not below 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks negatives): Q3 revenue finding -2.0 to -1.5; FY guide finding -1.5 to -1.2.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the capex funding-gap finding went from -0.5 to 0.0, because the money funds 862MW of YTD wins plus reservations and a REIT recycling channel exists. The range was kept wide for dilution risk.
Lesson 5 (proxy and unexplained drawdown): Tencent/Alibaba capex proxy +1.0 to +0.8; positioning/capitulation +2.0 to +1.5, because part of it leaned on the drawdown having no cause.
Lesson 2 (one-offs small): convertible fair-value gain +0.3 to +0.2.
p_up moved 53 to 52 (lesson 3/7 balance); abs_move_pct left at 12.
